items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And there was Dizzy Gillespie, Don Byas, Max Roach, Oscar Pettiford

ctx.x: This is 1942. December of '42. And there was Dizzy Gillespie, Don Byas, Max Roach, Oscar Pettiford, and a little piano out there that Dizzy was trying to teach how to play the piano named George Wallington. George later wrote 'Lemon Drops', you know.
